features.title: Color: Brownstone
features.text: Inviting in form and function, this super cozy bed is designed to provide optimum comfort for pets of all ages. The traditional sofa design features three-sided fluffy bolsters for extra cushioned loft, as well as great orthopedic support for both cats and dogs.

features.title: Sleep Surface
features.text: The sleep surface is lined with high pile faux fur fabric that is luxuriously soft and plush to the touch, a great complement to the equally smooth and downy micro velvet fabric covering the sides and bolsters.

features.title: Bolster Design
features.text: The fluffy-filled bolsters are lightweight but supportive. The three-sided design ensures plenty of high-loft headrest cushion, as well as cozy nooks and crannies for pets to burrow into. The bolsters also provide great orthopedic support for aching joints.

features.title: Cooling Gel Foam Top
features.text: The cooling gel top foam core contains microgel beads that help reduce heat to keep your pet cool during warmer climate. Infused with memory foam contouring properties, it also assists in providing superior orthopedic support and aids in soothing pressure points for a more restorative night's rest.

features.title: CertiPUR-US Certified Foam
features.text: Our foam is 100% manufactured in the USA and independently tested through the CertiPUR-US program to ensure that it meets the standards for content, emissions, and durability*. To reduce our carbon footprint, our beds may be shipped under compression; allow up to 48 hours for the foam to expand and regain its original shape. For bolsters, gently squeeze and loosen any clumped fill material to promote better recovery after compression.

features.title: Sizes & Dimensions
features.text: Small: 20" x 15" x 6" (3" Base Foam Height); For dogs up to 20 lbs

authors_reviews.title: 65 Pound Pitbull Beds - Worry-Free 60 Day Program
authors_reviews.text: So... I have two 65 lb. Pittie’s and they generally don’t tear things up that aren’t meant to be torn up. Dog toys and such have a short shelf life, but outside of the puppy stage the furniture and most items around the house are safe. For that reason, I thought the two new Furhaven beds I bought them were safe. Nope, for some unknown reason I was gone for a morning and I came home to find one shredded.Ugh. To say I was pissed is a massive understatement. I was seriously ready to kill them. They were “this close” to being... passed on! No more! Ceased to be! Expired and gone to meet their maker! Stiffs! Bereft of life, and resting in peace! Pushing up the daisies! Their metabolic processes being history! Off the twig! Kicked the bucket, and shuffled off their mortal coils, run down the curtain and joined the bleedin' choir invisible!! THEY WERE THIS CLOSE TO BEING EX-PITTIES!!After a bit of yelling and screaming and putting the fear of dog in them cooler heads prevailed. It took me a couple of days to summon the energy to clean up the pieces of the bed, but in doing so realized that I just might be covered under the Furhaven “Worry-Free 60 Day Program”... and I was. I contacted Furhaven and emailed them photos of what was left of the bed and they sent me a new replacement. Thank You Furhaven.As the beds go they are really nice. I purchased two of the:Furhaven Pet Bed for Dogs and Cats - Plush and Velvet Waves Perfect Comfort Sofa-Style Cooling Gel Foam Dog Bed, Removable Machine Washable Cover - Granite Gray, Large ( Item / model number: ‎88449537)For my two 65 lb. Pitbulls these large beds are a perfect size. They easily fit one to one and a half dogs, and since my younger 5-year-old female has no concept of personal space they are often both found in one of the beds together. The quality seems fine... unless your Pitbulls are on a, ummm, tear. They are nice and soft. About the only thing I can think of, only word of advice is to maybe take them apart and wash them once a month. When the one got shredded it prompted me to wash the one that wasn’t and it was dirtier inside on the foam and cooling gel bit than I thought it would be. Long story short, I am quite happy with having found and purchased these beds.
authors_reviews.author: Ronald B.

authors_reviews.title: The best dog bed ever
authors_reviews.text: Here are the benefits I see with this bed. It’s well made, easy to wash, substantial bolster pillows surrounded the bed and a deep memory foam mattress for my dogs bones. I don’t know how chew proof these beds are since I have never had a dog that felt the need to chew on their bed. Chewing is a natural teething behavior and anything beyond teething is an owner not keeping their dog stimulated enough. Chewing is a way a dog can let their owner know that they are bored. To stop this behavior one needs to stimulate their dog with play or teach them more words and actions. Dogs don’t speak languages but they will get attention from owners the only way they have been successful in the past.These beds seem to be very well made and very sturdy. I’m impressed with the thickness of the mattress and the overall quality of every single detail from stitching to fabulous bolsters to being able to hold their shape. I could have save myself a fortune in money if I had simply pulled the trigger and purchased a fabulous bed to begin with.I did put a pillow in the bed so my dog can rough up the mattress and make it her own space. Hahaha. The first day she had the bed the usual three turns ended up being 10 turns and a lot of rutting in the mattress so I realized she needed to have something in there to make it her own space. I purchased the Jumbo for my 110 lbs dog. She loves to stretch out and she can with her head hanging over the sturdy but soft bolster. This is definitely not a paid review it’s my personal honest thoughts regarding this dog bed.The cooling part of the mattress is easy to feel with my hand but I’m not sure how this is transferred into my dog’s behavior. I live in the desert and my home is kept at 74° for my dogs comfort. They have fur coats they simply can’t take off. I’m sure I will find my dear dogs resting in their new beds more and more as we get into cooler weather. The one thing I did notice is that my dogs are choosing their new beds vs sleeping with me on my latex foam bed. This is totally new for me. It does let me know that this dog bed next to my personal bed the dogs will cuddle with meat first then end up in their own beds on the floor. This is THE FIRST I have ever experienced this behavior. Usually they hog my bed until I am totally uncomfortable and searching for some real estate. Ha! So I’m basically just watching my dogs behavior and speaking to what I am witnessing. They ( my dogs) love these beds.I will be purchasing more so they will have beds in the living room as well as my bedroom so I don’t have to take the beds back and forth. These beds are large and substantial. I simply don’t have enough good things to say. I bet with these bumpers that these beds would be great to travel for little kids as well. These beds are this good.If you are on the fence and your choice is because of $20.00 or $30.00 price point I would definitely say just get this bed- it will save you money in many many dog beds. Don’t end up with 10-15 pet beds that are all inferior. I have tried this. Please learn from my mistakes and save yourself money in the long run. Just buy one. The size recommended on the bed is very good so if you are unsure please trust their recommendations. Don’t buy a bed that’s too small for your fur Angel . If anything go larger. This is such a great bed. For the price of a tank of gas - you will have a happy dog. Thank you!
authors_reviews.author: Miss Lilly

authors_reviews.title: Absolutely the best dog bed!
authors_reviews.text: This is our second Furhaven bed. This product is exceptional! My dog is 110lbs and it provides great support for him with nice fluffy bolsters to rest his head. He has dug on on both beds and no rips. It’s also nice that the cover can be removed and machine washable. It’s nice if you have a pup or elder dog that has accidents. *Just a tip, you can also add a waterproof pad inside over the bed mattress to keep urine or “whatever” from seeping through to preserve the integrity of the mattress and keep it more hygienic. Also made in the USA, so no funky materials or weird odor. My dog loves it, I highly recommend!
authors_reviews.author: Randy and Lisa M.

authors_reviews.title: Very Nice Bed
authors_reviews.text: So I searched for a bed SIZE that met my needs, found lots of slightly too small or too big options. I wanted "real," memory foam but this foam with the cooling gel works well enough since the way more expensive beds with "real" memory foam didn't come in a size I wanted. Size wise, this one works perfectly for my Cavalier King Charles Spaniel. So for anyone with a 15-25 lb dog, this is a good size and the foam is firm enough for that weight. I wanted room for my pup to stretch out as she is in the picture even though she's not completely in the bed :-) and also be able to curl up in a corner and use the bolster for a chin/head rest, this works nicely for both. Its very soft and made well enough for sleeping, if your dog chews their bed, this may not be the best option. My pup is about 13.5 lbs in the pics, 5 months old, so she'll get a little bigger.
authors_reviews.author: Michael
